items.question: How do I send you my footage?
items.answer: Share a folder link with your clips, notes and examples. We organise everything before editing starts.

items.question: Can you work from phone footage?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly edit iPhone, DSLR, podcast and screen-recorded footage into platform-ready clips.

items.question: Do you write captions and hooks?
items.answer: Yes. Every plan includes clear subtitles, opening hooks and simple posting notes.

items.question: Can I request a specific editing style?
items.answer: Yes. Send reference videos or brand guidance and we will match the pace, colour and tone.

items.question: How quickly do I receive finished videos?
items.answer: Most weekly batches are returned within three to five working days after we receive the footage.
